summary_en: VitalikButerin said the EF is entering a period of mild austerity for the next five years to deliver an aggressive roadmap while staying sustainable. pcaversaccio said his Safe signer is fully funded through Tornado Cash and secures over $220M. mikeneuder and maryam analyzed application controlled execution and Hyperliquid's cancel prioritization. weiihann measured the effect of keeping only one year of active state.
